subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Doctor, Patient, Indian citizen
solution:
The correct Venn diagram representation is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/755352228fc0f217d157f06b9738d64414ae821ead7d1ef606d2028693a29282.png] 

Some doctors can be patients and Indian citizens.

Some Indian citizens can be doctors and patients.

Some patients can be Indian citizens and doctors.

That's why three of the circles are overlapping partially.

Hence, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51d2ea791b0e7aa7bee3fe0db09fe21421be449be8bade8d698a83a9bd792892.png] i.e. **option 2 **is the** correct answer**.
